# QuickBillFree — Free Online Invoice Generator & Instant Bill Maker

> QuickBillFree is a fast, 100% free, client-side web application for generating professional vector PDF invoices with zero sign-up, zero watermarks, and built-in payment QR codes.

## Core Capabilities
- **Zero Registration & No Login:** Users can create, customize, and download invoices immediately without submitting an email or creating an account.
- **Client-Side Privacy:** All customer data, line items, rates, and logos are processed exclusively in the user's browser using HTML5 LocalStorage. No private financial data is sent to or stored on external servers.
- **Instant Vector PDF Generation:** Generates print-ready US Letter and A4 PDF documents with sharp typography and zero branding watermarks.
- **Dynamic Payment QR Codes:** Automatically generates scannable QR codes for Venmo, PayPal, Wise, Stripe, and bank transfer links directly onto the invoice document.
- **Automated Math & Currency:** Real-time computation of subtotals, custom discounts, shipping, regional sales tax/VAT, with support for 50+ international currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, INR, etc.).
- **Progressive Web App (PWA):** Operates 100% offline without an active internet connection.
